faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Anna University Clerical/Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application form for Anna University Clerical/Office Assistant Recruitment 2026 is 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Anna University Clerical/Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Clerical/Office Assistant post in Anna University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for Anna University Clerical/Office Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for Anna University Clerical/Office Assistant posts is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Clerical/Office Assistant post at Anna University?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Clerical/Office Assistant post will receive a salary of Rs. 15000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Clerical/Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in Economics / Commerce / Finance and allied subjects, with desirable experience in accounts or related fields.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Anna University Clerical/Office Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Anna University Clerical/Office Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on qualification and experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Clerical/Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Clerical/Office Assistant post is Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.answer: The official website for Anna University recruitment related to this post is www.uicbannauniv.com.
